# function: profile_object_types

Builds the ARN for `profile` `object-types`:

```
arn:${Partition}:profile:${Region}:${Account}:domains/${DomainName}/object-types/${ObjectTypeName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:profile:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:domains/domain-name/object-types/object-type-name
output "profile_object_types" {
  value = provider::arn::profile_object_types("domain-name", "object-type-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
profile_object_types(domain_name string, object_type_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `domain_name` (String) Value for `${DomainName}` in the ARN template.
1. `object_type_name` (String) Value for `${ObjectTypeName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
